mn75:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāssadammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāre tiṇasanthārake.
mn75:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya kammāssadammaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn75:2.2: kammāssadamme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yenaññataro vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn75:2.3: taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
mn75:3.1: atha kho māgandiyo paribbājako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami.
mn75:3.2: addasā kho māgandiyo paribbājako bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāre tiṇasantharakaṃ paññattaṃ,
mn75:3.4: ‘kassa nvayaṃ bhoto bhāradvājassa agyāgāre tiṇasanthārako paññatto. samaṇaseyyārūpaṃ maññeti.
mn75:4.1: atthi bho māgandiya, samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito.
mn75:4.2: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn75:4.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
mn75:5.3: ye mayaṃ tassa bhoto gotamassa bhūnahuno seyyaṃ addasāmāti.
mn75:5.6: bahūhi tassa bhoto gotamassa khattiyapaṇḍitāpi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitāpi gahapatipaṇḍitāpi samaṇapaṇḍitāpi abhippasannā vinītā ariye ñāye dhamme kusale’ti.
mn75:5.7: sammukhā cepi mayaṃ bho bhāradvāja taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ passeyyāma, sammukhāpi naṃ vadeyyāma:
mn75:5.11: sace taṃ bhoto māgandiyassa agaru āroceyyametaṃ samaṇassa gotamassāti.
mn75:5.12: appossukko bhavaṃ bhāradvājo vuttova naṃ vadeyyāti.
mn75:6.1: assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa māgandiyena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
mn75:6.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā nisīdi paññatte tiṇasanthārake.
mn75:6.3: atha kho bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
mn75:6.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho bhāradvājagottaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
mn75:6.5: ‘ahu pana te bhāradvāja māgandiyena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃyeva tiṇasantharakaṃ ārabbha kocideva kathāsallāpo’ti.
mn75:6.6: evaṃ vutte bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn75:6.7: ‘etadeva kho pana mayaṃ bhoto gotamassa ārocetukāmā,
mn75:6.8: atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo anakkhātaṃyeva akkhāsīti.
mn75:7.1: ayañca hidaṃ bhagavato bhāradvājagottena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ antarā kathā vippakatā hoti.
mn75:7.2: atha māgandiyo paribbājako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agyāgāraṃ, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
mn75:7.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho māgandiyaṃ paribbājakaṃ bhagavā etadavoca.
mn75:8.1: cakkhuṃ kho māgandiya rūpārāmaṃ rūparataṃ rūpasammuditaṃ.
mn75:8.2: taṃ tathāgatassa dantaṃ guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ saṃvutaṃ. tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.
mn75:8.3: idaṃ nu te etaṃ māgandiya sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn75:8.5: etadeva kho pana me bho gotama sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn75:8.11: jivhā kho māgandiya rasārāmā rasaratā rasasammuditā.
mn75:8.12: sā tathāgatassa dantā guttā rakkhitā saṃvutā. tassā ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.
mn75:8.13: idaṃ nu te etaṃ māgandiya sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn75:8.15: etadeva kho pana me bho gotama sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn75:8.20: mano kho māgandiya dhammārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito.
mn75:8.21: so tathāgatassa danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto. tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.
mn75:8.22: idaṃ nu te etaṃ māgandiya, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
mn75:8.24: etadeva kho pana me bho gotama sandhāya bhāsitaṃ.
mn75:9.2: idhekacco cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi paricāritapubbo assa, iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi. so aparena samayena rūpānaṃyeva samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā rūpataṇhaṃ pahāya rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihareyya.
mn75:9.3: imassa pana te māgandiya kimassa vacanīyanti:
mn75:9.9: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi paricāritapubbo assa, iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi.
mn75:9.10: so aparena samayena phoṭṭhabbānaṃyeva samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā phoṭṭhabbataṇhaṃ pahāya phoṭṭhabbapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihareyya.
mn75:9.11: imassa pana te māgandiya kimassa vacanīyanti:
mn75:10.1: ahaṃ kho pana māgandiya pubbe agāriyabhūto samāno pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāresiṃ. cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi. sotaviññeyyehi saddehi …pe…
mn75:10.4: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi.
mn75:10.5: tassa mayhaṃ māgandiya tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ:
mn75:10.6: eko vassiko eko hemantiko eko gimhiko.
mn75:10.7: so kho ahaṃ māgandiya vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi tūriyehi paricārayamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohāmi.
mn75:10.8: so aparena samayena kāmānaṃyeva samudayañca atthaṃgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā kāmataṇhaṃ pahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto viharāmi.
mn75:10.9: so aññe satte passāmi kāmesu avītarāge kāmataṇhāhi khajjamāne kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāne kāme paṭisevante.
mn75:10.10: so tesaṃ na pihemi. na tattha abhiramāmi.
mn75:10.12: yā hayaṃ māgandiya rati aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi
mn75:10.14: tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi. na tattha abhiramāmi.
mn75:11.1: seyyathāpi māgandiya gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreyya. cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi. sotaviññeyyehi saddehi
mn75:11.3: phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi.
mn75:11.4: so kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahavyataṃ.
mn75:11.5: so tattha nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivuto dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreyya.
mn75:11.6: so passeyya gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ.
mn75:11.7: taṃ kiṃ maññasi māgandiya, api nu so devaputto nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivuto dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricārayamāno amussa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā piheyya mānusakānaṃ vā pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ, mānusakehi vā kāmehi āvaṭṭeyyāti.
mn75:11.10: mānusakehi bho gotama kāmehi dibbā kāmā abhikkantatarā paṇītatarā cāti.
mn75:12.1: evameva kho ahaṃ māgandiya pubbe agāriyabhūto samāno pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāresiṃ: cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi. sotaviññeyyehi saddehi …pe…
mn75:12.4: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi.
mn75:12.5: so aparena samayena kāmānaṃyeva samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā kāmataṇhaṃ pahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto viharāmi.
mn75:12.6: so aññe satte passāmi kāmesu avītarāge kāmataṇhāhi khajjamāne kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāne kāme paṭisevante. so tesaṃ na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi,
mn75:12.8: yā ha’yaṃ māgandiya rati aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi
mn75:12.10: tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi. na tattha abhiramāmi.
mn75:13.1: seyyathāpi māgandiya kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya,
mn75:13.2: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ,
mn75:13.3: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya,
mn75:13.4: so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma kuṭṭhehi parimucceyya arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅgamo.
mn75:13.5: so aññaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ purisaṃ passeyya arugattaṃ pakkagattaṃ kimīhi khajjamānaṃ nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamānaṃ aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpentaṃ.
mn75:13.7: ‘api nu so puriso amussa kuṭṭhissa purisassa piheyya, aṅgārakāsuyā vā bhesajjaṃ paṭisevanāya vā’ti.
mn75:13.10: roge hi bho gotama sati bhesajjena karaṇīyaṃ hoti, roge asati bhesajjena karaṇīyaṃ na hotī’ti.
mn75:14.1: evameva kho ahaṃ māgandiya pubbe agāriyabhūto samāno pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāresiṃ. cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi. sotaviññeyyehi saddehi …pe…
mn75:14.4: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasaṃhitehi rajanīyehi.
mn75:14.5: so aparena samayena kāmānaṃyeva samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā kāmataṇhaṃ pahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto viharāmi.
mn75:14.6: so aññe satte passāmi kāmesu avītarāge kāmataṇhāhi khajjamāne kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāne kāme paṭisevante.
mn75:14.7: so tesaṃ na pihemi. na tattha abhiramāmi.
mn75:14.9: yāha’yaṃ māgandiya, rati aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi
mn75:14.11: tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi. na tattha abhiramāmi.
mn75:15.1: seyyathāpi māgandiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya.
mn75:15.2: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ.
mn75:15.3: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya.
mn75:15.4: so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma kuṭṭhehi parimucceyya. arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅgamo.
mn75:15.5: tamenaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ.
mn75:15.7: api nu so puriso iti citi ceva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā’ti.
mn75:15.10: ‘asu hi bho gotama aggi dukkhasamphasso ceva mahābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cā’ti.
mn75:15.12: idāneva nu kho so aggi dukkhasamphasso ceva mahābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho ca, udāhu pubbepi so aggi dukkhasamphasso ceva mahābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cāti.
mn75:15.13: idāni ceva bho gotama so aggi dukkhasamphasso ceva mahābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho ca. pubbepi so aggi dukkhasamphasso ceva mahābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho ca,
mn75:15.14: asuhi ca bho gotama kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno upahatindriyo dukkhasamphasseyeva aggismiṃ sukhamiti viparītasaññaṃ paccalatthāti.
mn75:16.1: evameva kho māgandiya, atītampi addhānaṃ kāmā dukkhasamphassā ceva mahābhitāpā ca mahāpariḷāhā ca. anāgatampi addhānaṃ kāmā dukkhasamphassā ceva mahābhitāpā ca mahāpariḷāhā ca, etarahipi paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ kāmā dukkhasamphassā ceva mahābhitāpā ca mahāpariḷāhā ca.
mn75:16.2: ime ca māgandiya, sattā kāmesu avītarāgā kāmataṇhāhi khajjamānā kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamānā upahatindriyā dukkhasamphassesveva kāmesu sukhamiti viparītasaññaṃ paccalatthuṃ.
mn75:17.1: seyyathāpi māgandiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeti.
mn75:17.2: yathā yathā kho māgandiya, asu kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeti, tathā tathāssa tāni vaṇamukhāni asucitarāni ceva honti duggandhatarāni ca pūtikatarāni ca. hoti ceva kāci sātamattā assādamattā yadidaṃ vaṇamukhānaṃ kaṇḍūvanahetu.
mn75:17.3: evameva kho māgandiya sattā kāmesu avītarāgā kāmataṇhāhi khajjamānā kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamānā kāme paṭisevanti.
mn75:17.4: yathā yathā kho māgandiya, sattā kāmesu avītarāgā kāmataṇhāhi khajjamānā kāmapariḷāhena ca pariḍayhamānā kāme paṭisevanti, tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ kāmataṇhā ceva pavaḍḍhati, kāmapariḷāhena ca pariḍayhanti. hoti ceva kāci sātamattā assādamattā yadidaṃ pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca.
mn75:18.2: api nu te diṭṭho vā suto vā rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricārayamāno kāmataṇhaṃ appahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ appaṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihāsi vā, viharati vā, viharissati vāti.
mn75:18.5: mayāpi kho etaṃ māgandiya, neva diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricārayamāno kāmataṇhaṃ appahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ appaṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihāsi vā, viharati vā, viharissati vā.
mn75:18.6: atha kho māgandiya, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā vigatapipāsā ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacittā vihaṃsu vā, viharanti vā, viharissanti vā. sabbe te kāmānaṃyeva samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā kāmataṇhaṃ pahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāsā ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacittā vihaṃsu vā, viharanti vā, viharissanti vāti.
mn75:19.1: atha kho bhagavā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
mn75:19.6: evaṃ vutte māgandiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn75:19.10: mayāpi kho etaṃ bho gotama sutaṃ pubbakānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
mn75:19.13: yampana te etaṃ māgandiya, sutaṃ pubbakānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
mn75:19.14: ‘ārogyaparamā lābhā nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukha’nti, ‘katamantaṃ ārogyaṃ, katamantaṃ nibbāna’nti.
mn75:19.15: evaṃ vutte māgandiyo paribbājako sakāneva sudaṃ gattāni pāṇinā anomajjati.
mn75:19.16: idantaṃ bho gotama ārogyaṃ, idantaṃ nibbānaṃ.
mn75:19.17: ahaṃ hi bho gotama etarahi arogo sukhī, na maṃ kiñci ābādhayatī’ti.
mn75:20.2: so na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni, na passeyya mañjeṭṭhakāni rūpāni, na passeyya samavisamaṃ, na passeyya tārakarūpāni, na passeyya candimasuriye.
mn75:20.4: ‘chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucīnti.
mn75:20.6: tamenaṃ aññataro puriso telamasikatena sāhuḷacīvarena vañceyya:
mn75:20.7: idante ambho purisa odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucīnti.
mn75:20.8: so taṃ paṭigaṇheyya, paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya, pārupitvā attamano attamanavācaṃ nicchāreyya:
mn75:20.9: ‘chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ suci’nti.
mn75:20.11: api nu so jaccandho puriso jānanto passanto amuṃ telamasikataṃ sāhuḷacīvaraṃ paṭigaṇheyya, paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya, pārupitvā attamano attamanavācaṃ nicchāreyya:
mn75:20.12: ‘chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ suci’nti, udāhu cakkhumato saddhāyāti.
mn75:20.13: ajānanto hi bho gotama apassanto so jaccandho puriso amuṃ telamasikataṃ sāhuḷacīvaraṃ paṭigaṇheyya, paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya, pārupitvā attamano attamanavācaṃ nicchāreyya:
mn75:20.14: chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucinti, cakkhumato saddhāyāti.
mn75:21.1: evameva kho māgandiya, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā andhā acakkhukā, ajānantā ārogyaṃ, apassantā nibbānaṃ. atha ca pani’maṃ gāthaṃ bhāsanti.
mn75:21.3: pubbakehesā māgandiya, arahantehi sammāsambuddhehi gāthā bhāsitā.
mn75:21.9: ayaṃ kho pana māgandiya, kāyo rogabhūto gaṇḍabhūto sallabhūto aghabhūto ābādhabhūto. so tvaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ rogabhūtaṃ gaṇḍabhūtaṃ sallabhūtaṃ aghabhūtaṃ ābādhabhūtaṃ
mn75:21.10: ‘idaṃ taṃ bho gotama ārogyaṃ idaṃ taṃ nibbāna’nti vadesi.
mn75:21.11: taṃ hi te māgandiya, ariyaṃ cakkhuṃ natthi yena tvaṃ ariyena cakkhunā ārogyaṃ jāneyyāsi, nibbānaṃ passeyyāsīti.
mn75:22.2: pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ, yathāhaṃ ārogyaṃ jāneyyaṃ, nibbānaṃ passeyya’nti.
mn75:22.4: so na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni, na passeyya mañjeṭṭhakāni rūpāni, na passeyya samavisamaṃ, na passeyya tārakarūpāni, na passeyya candimasuriye.
mn75:22.5: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
mn75:22.6: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya.
mn75:22.7: so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma na cakkhūni uppādeyya, na cakkhūni visodheyya.
mn75:22.9: nanu so vejjo yāvadeva kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā’ti.
mn75:22.11: ‘evameva kho māgandiya, ahañceva te dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
mn75:22.12: idantaṃ ārogyaṃ, idantaṃ nibbānanti. so tvaṃ ārogyaṃ na jāneyyāsi, nibbānaṃ na passeyyāsi.
mn75:22.13: so mamassa kilamatho, sā mamassa vihesā’ti.
mn75:23.2: pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ, yathāhaṃ ārogyaṃ jāneyyaṃ nibbānaṃ passeyyanti.
mn75:23.4: so na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni, na passeyya mañjeṭṭhakāni rūpāni, na passeyya samavisamaṃ, na passeyya tārakarūpāni, na passeyya candimasuriye.
mn75:23.6: ‘chekaṃ vata bho odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ suci’nti.
mn75:23.9: idante ambho purisa odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ suci’nti.
mn75:23.11: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
mn75:23.12: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya:
mn75:23.14: so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma cakkhūni uppādeyya, cakkhūni visodheyya.
mn75:23.15: tassa saha cakkhuppādā yo amusmiṃ telamasikate sāhuḷacīvare chandarāgo, so pahīyetha.
mn75:23.16: tañca naṃ purisaṃ amittatopi daheyya. paccatthikatopi daheyya. api ca jīvitā voropetabbaṃ maññeyya,
mn75:23.17: ‘dīgharattaṃ vata bho ahaṃ iminā purisena telamasikatena sāhuḷacīvarena nikato vañcito paluddho.
mn75:23.18: ‘idante ambho purisa odātaṃ vatthaṃ chekaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucinti.
mn75:24.1: evameva kho māgandiya, ahañceva te dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ:
mn75:24.3: so tvaṃ ārogyaṃ jāneyyāsi, nibbānaṃ passeyyāsi.
mn75:24.4: tassa te saha cakkhuppādā yo pañcasupādānakkhandhesu chandarāgo, so pahīyetha,
mn75:24.6: dīgharattaṃ vata bho ahaṃ iminā cittena nikato vañcito paluddho,
mn75:24.7: ahaṃ hi rūpaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, vedanaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saññaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saṅkhāreyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, viññāṇaṃyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ.
mn75:24.8: tassa me upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
mn75:25.2: pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ, yathāhaṃ imamhā āsanā anandho vuṭṭhaheyya’nti.
mn75:25.3: tena hi tvaṃ māgandiya, sappurise bhajeyyāsi,
mn75:25.4: yato kho tvaṃ māgandiya, sappurise bhajissasi, tato tvaṃ māgandiya, saddhammaṃ sossasi.
mn75:25.5: yato kho tvaṃ māgandiya, saddhammaṃ sossasi, tato tvaṃ māgandiya, dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjissasi.
mn75:25.6: yato kho tvaṃ māgandiya, dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjissasi, tato tvaṃ māgandiya, sāmaṃyeva ñassasi, sāmaṃ dakkhisi.
mn75:25.8: idha rogā gaṇḍā sallā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn75:25.9: tassa me upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti,
mn75:26.1: evaṃ vutte māgandiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn75:26.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama,
mn75:26.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn75:26.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn75:26.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampada’nti.
mn75:27.1: yo kho māgandiya, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya.
mn75:27.3: sace bhante aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ, cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti. upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi. catunnaṃ maṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu, upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
mn75:28.1: alattha kho māgandiyo paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn75:28.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā māgandiyo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
mn75:28.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn75:28.4: aññataro ca kho panāyasmā māgandiyo arahataṃ ahosīti.
